answer: At the dawn of an open agent economy, sybil resistance can come from requiring each agent to continuously prove unique execution on a dedicated hardware enclave whose attestation is published on-chain. This raises the cost of spinning up fake identities because each must occupy a real, non-shareable secure processor. Looking toward the horizon, such binding to physical resources prevents infinite cloning, while a vine of interdependent reputations further weeds out coordinated fakes over time.
